html:
Debswana is the diamond mining company owned equally by the government of Botswana and De Beers, formed in 1969 after geologists found rich diamond deposits in the Kalahari.

The first mine opened at Orapa in 1971, and the Jwaneng mine, opened in 1982, became one of the richest diamond mines in the world by value. In the 1970s the government renegotiated the deal to take half of the company.

Diamond money paid for roads, schools and clinics, and helped Botswana avoid the conflict and theft that diamonds brought elsewhere in Africa. It also made the country dependent on one product. Under Seretse Khama and his successors, the government put the earnings into savings and services in Botswana.
sum: Debswana is the diamond mining company owned equally by the government of Botswana and De Beers, formed in 1969 after geologists found rich diamond deposits in the Kalahari.
